toegepas.voor: in dieselfde land en deel hulle een toekoms
toegepas.na: in dieselfde land, en deel hulle een toekoms
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('hulle deel'), so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: after 'Tog' the inversion carries over, so 'deel hulle' is a second clause with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by AWS 2017 and changes nothing in the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Bo is 'n breë rooi strook en onder
toegepas.na: Bo is 'n breë rooi strook, en onder
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('strook is').
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by AWS 2017 and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: For two stripes (things, not people) 'daartussen' is the idiomatic form; 'tussen hulle' reads like a translation.
toegepas.fout: 'Tussen hulle' uses a personal pronoun for things (stripes), which copies English; Afrikaans uses the pronominal adverb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daartussen' is the correct Afrikaans form for things and still means between the red and blue stripes.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A day cannot 'onthou' (remember); 'herdenk' (commemorate) is the natural verb with a day as subject. Apply with the other three list items or not at all.
toegepas.fout: A day as subject cannot 'onthou' (remember); the natural verb is 'herdenk'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'herdenk' is the precise verb for a commemorative day, Grade 6 readers know it, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.fout: A day as subject cannot 'onthou'; same fault as change 1 of the list.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same fix as the Menseregtedag item, keeping the list's items consistent.

toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dit herdenk hoe ... gestig het' reads naturally and keeps the four items consistent.

toegepas.rede_vinder: After the inversion 'hulle' reads as 'their food' rather than as the subject; the subject 'party mense' already carries over, so the pronoun can go.
toegepas.fout: After the inversion, 'kook hulle kos' can read as 'cook their food', and 'hulle' appears three times in one sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Dropping the pronoun keeps 'party mense' as the subject, removes the ambiguity and leaves the meaning intact.

laat_vaar.voor: deel van die hele Suid-Afrika se erfenis
laat_vaar.na: deel van die erfenis van die hele Suid-Afrika
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'die hele Suid-Afrika se erfenis' is a clumsy possessive; the 'van' construction reads more naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die hele Suid-Afrika se erfenis' is normal Afrikaans and mirrors 'Elke gemeenskap se erfenis' earlier in the sentence; the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Die land het nog nasionale simbole
laat_vaar.na: Die land het ook ander nasionale simbole
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'het nog' can read as 'still has'; 'ook ander' says plainly that there are further symbols.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die land het nog nasionale simbole, soos ...' is idiomatic for 'further symbols' and the list that follows rules out 'still has'; lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: en baie mense help op dié dag ander
laat_vaar.na: en op dié dag help baie mense ander
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Putting the time phrase first avoids the awkward 'help op dié dag ander' split of verb and object.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'baie mense help op dié dag ander' is ordinary Afrikaans word order with the adverbial before the object; the proposal only reorders it.
